name: Big Eau Pleine County Park, South Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split from 3535 2026-11-21. Site coordinates from the county reservation engine (https://www.parks.marathoncounty.gov/wausau-marathon/reservation/campgrounds/4a02962c-ea10-402e-bb6d-7d7dec475b89, read 2026-11-21) plotted on Esri World_Imagery read 2026-11-21 at 44.73643,-89.83676 (230 m half-width) and 44.7356,-89.8370 (140 m), both rendered, with 44.7395,-89.8440 (1,100 m) and 44.7420,-89.8460 (750 m) for context. The engine's 'lakeside' sites 072, 074, 076, 078, 080 and 082 ('shaded with a view of the flowage') sit under continuous canopy about 35-40 m back from the tree line and ~55 m from the water at the drawdown beach; nothing between is open ground. The county South Unit map (Cedar PDF, 'Updated September 2026', read 2026-11-21) draws a shoreline walking trail SE of 074-078 and a road from the loop's SE corner to a second boat launch. No site on open ground within ~50 m of the water -> lakeview. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Marathon County reservation engine, South Campground facility (https://www.parks.marathoncounty.gov/wausau-marathon/reservation/campgrounds/4a02962c-ea10-402e-bb6d-7d7dec475b89, read 2026-11-21): 'The South Campground at Big Eau Pleine Park provides 60 campsites in a wooded setting near the park's trails, picnic areas and reservoir access. The campground includes both electric and non-electric sites'; per-site data: gravel pads 40-60 ft (only 084 at 40 ft), 53 reservable sites, 5 walk-in-only sites, 2 administrative; reservable up to 365 days ahead. A real county drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. Own spur road: Eau Pleine Park Rd forks north of both campgrounds and the east branch runs about 1 km south to this loop (Esri World_Street_Map read 2026-11-21; the county South Unit map shows the loop on its own road off the park road). 1.40 km centroid to centroid from the West campground.
note: The wooded campground of Marathon County's Big Eau Pleine park, on a peninsula in the Big Eau Pleine Reservoir west of Mosinee: one shaded loop near the south shore with a boat launch, picnic area and firewood sales close by, and a shoreline walking trail. The West campground, about 1.4 km away on its own road beside the beach and disc golf, has its own entry. --Claude

hookups.note: Sites 048-070 have electric (the county counts 24 electric sites); the amperage is not posted.

sites.note: Sites 047-106 less administrative sites 047 and 055. 099, 101, 103, 105 and 106 are walk-in, first-come, non-electric.

facilities.note: Water from pressurized-well pumps; the park dump station is open 8 am - 8 pm ($8).

season.note: October is first-come only: reservations cover May 1 - September 30.

booking.note: Five sites are first-come only. Online reservations close 3 days before arrival; an unreserved site may be self-registered on site for up to 3 nights (cash or check), and in October every site is first-come. Check-in 3 pm.

fees.note: 2026: $23 for a non-electric site, $25 for the lakeside non-electric sites, $28 with electric. The online engine quotes $25.59 (non-electric) and $30.33 (electric) a night for residents, $1.90 more for non-residents. Cancelling costs $10.
